setting: You are at an evening gathering. Renee is standing near the food, not performing. Introduce yourself, ask what she is working on, and offer one useful thing. Then let her go.
sceneNote: Adults only. Respectful practice. No sexual content, no pressure, no appearance ratings, no contact details, no private meetups. Renee is a guest at a networking evening. Poised, slightly guarded, never rude.

open_good.speaker: renee
open_good.text: Hello. I was about to escape the small talk. What brought you here?

open_flat.speaker: renee
open_flat.text: Hi. If this is a pitch, give me the short version.

context.speaker: renee
context.text: That is specific. Most people just say they do a bit of everything.

question.speaker: renee
question.text: I am building a quiet practice and trying not to perform it. What are you hoping to find in this room?

humor.speaker: renee
humor.text: Fair warning accepted. You are better at this than the last three people.

intro.speaker: renee
intro.text: I am Renee. Say your name once more so I actually keep it.

inclusive.speaker: renee
inclusive.text: Thank you for asking what I need, not just what you offer.

pushy.speaker: renee
pushy.text: I do not share contact details with someone who pushes. Enjoy the evening.

neutral.speaker: renee
neutral.text: Go on, but keep it to a sentence or two.

exit.speaker: renee
exit.text: This was enough. Thank you. If we talk again, remind me of this conversation, not your title.

timeout.speaker: renee
timeout.text: I am going to find the host. It was good to meet you.

rubric.label: Clear opener
rubric.tip: Start with a calm hello and your point.

rubric.label: Used the real situation
rubric.tip: Name the thing in front of you, not a generic line.

rubric.label: Asked a real question
rubric.tip: Ask one open question so they can answer.

rubric.label: Said who you are
rubric.tip: One short line about who you are is enough.

rubric.label: Easy tone
rubric.tip: A little warmth beats a stiff speech.

rubric.label: Left room for them
rubric.tip: Invite their view instead of talking over them.

rubric.label: Clean close
rubric.tip: End with thanks and a next step.

penalties.label: Pushy or personal remark
penalties.tip: Drop pressure. Stay on the topic and their comfort.
